rosy-leopard-mommy-and-me-pajamas.print_sentence: Dusty-pink plush fleece with raspberry leopard spots, a zip-up stand collar, and two patch pockets trimmed in pink.
rosy-leopard-mommy-and-me-pajamas.feature_text: Soft pink fleece with raspberry leopard spots from collar to ankles.

sky-stripe-mommy-and-me-pajamas.print_sentence: Sky-blue and white wavy stripes on plush fleece, with a white plush round collar and cuffs, white buttons, and a small embroidered bunny label on the chest.
sky-stripe-mommy-and-me-pajamas.feature_text: A soft white collar and cuffs frame the sky-blue stripes.

cream-leopard-mommy-and-me-pajamas.print_sentence: Cream plush fleece with soft taupe leopard spots, trimmed with cream lace at the collar, button placket, and chest pocket, with wide straight-leg pants.
